title: The Domain Is a Residue: Adapting Self-Supervised Features, Not Generators
abstract: arXiv:2609.37330v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Clearing fog, rain or snow from footage, or turning renders into photographs, must remove the source domain and keep the scene. Unpaired translators carry it through because their generator sees the source appearance (pixels, a near-invertible latent or a control map) and keeps it. A DINO feature map fixes what is in the scene and carries weather, lighting and rendering style as a residue of 13 to 14% of the feature norm. We propose the Representation Feature Adapter (RFA), a 2.9M-parameter network that moves this residue. We train only the adapter and its discriminators; the encoder and a feature-conditioned decoder, trained once for all conditions, stay frozen. Against CycleGAN-Turbo it is ahead on both metrics on fog and on KID on night, and level within noise on snow, rain and haze. On sim-to-real it leads REGEN and HyPER-GAN on both metrics. translated_title: 域即残差：适配自监督特征而非生成器
translated_abstract: 清除视频中的雾、雨或雪，或将渲染图转换为照片，必须去除源域信息并保留场景内容。非配对转换器之所以能做到这一点，是因为其生成器能看到源外观（像素、近乎可逆的潜在表示或控制图）并将其保留。DINO特征图固定了场景中的内容，而天气、光照和渲染风格则作为占特征范数13%到14%的残差被携带其中。我们提出了表示特征适配器（RFA），这是一个290万参数的网络，用于移除这一残差。我们仅训练适配器及其判别器；编码器和特征条件解码器（对所有条件仅训练一次）保持冻结。与CycleGAN-Turbo相比，该方法在雾天的两项指标以及夜间的KID指标上领先，在雪、雨和雾霾条件下表现相当（差异在噪声范围内）。在仿真到真实（sim-to-real）任务上，它在两项指标上均领先于REGEN和HyPER-GAN。只有RFA能够在去除雨滴的同时保留场景。这种去除以牺牲场景结构为代价：
tldr: 提出表示特征适配器（RFA），通过仅训练一个290万参数的适配器来移除冻结的DINO自监督特征中携带的域残差（占特征范数13-14%），从而在保留场景结构的同时实现去雾、去雨和仿真到真实的图像转换。
en_tdlr: Proposes the Representation Feature Adapter (RFA), a 2.9M-parameter network that removes the domain residue (13-14% of feature norm) carried in frozen DINO self-supervised features, enabling fog/rain removal and sim-to-real translation while preserving scene structure without retraining generators.
